# Aloe × schimperi Tod.

First published in Hort. Bot. Panorm. 1: 70 (1878)

This hybrid is accepted

The native range of this hybrid is Cape Prov. It is a succulent perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is A. maculata × A. striata.
